notes.title: Update V1.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888943/18cdefba995bd32e3bab0dcbc394804d8b32b80f.jpg[/img]

Greetings commanders,

Thank you for supporting us and enjoying the V1.0 release. As we promised we will keep looking into bugs and optimization and any arising issues. Here's the changes and fixes in this update:


A lot of changes in the UI

We got a lot of feedback on texts clarity and size, here's the changes made:


- Changed the text color in the  units descriptions in loadout
- Changed the text color in options
- Changed map names colors
- Increased the size of units blocks in loadout



Changes in tutorial:

-We changed the tutorial steps to make it more clear and less confusing by hiding some elements and showing them in appropriate times. Hopefully this will make the tutorial easier.


Gameplay:

- Player's unit health now will turn red when its less than halfway through, to indicate that it's in danger, so you can take action when it happens.

- Added an arrow to indicate the direction of the unit's before deploying.


Hopefully these changes will improve and ease the new players experience. Also we are still collecting reports and feedback from our players.


Enjoy gaming,
Northend Games Team

notes.title: Update V0.6
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888943/c97fbab432f04db912594adc754e9074faf280bb.png[/img]

[quote]Greetings commanders,

Update V0.6 is now available! 

New modes, a new boss, new enemies, enhancements, and bug fixes are all part of the latest version!

List of changes and additions are below. [/quote]







[previewyoutube=wYLlCmfXEzM;full][/previewyoutube]









[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888943/aaf8f1509e88638fdf9509be8f30b3d030fd18f6.png[/img]




[h2]NEW MODES[/h2] There are now 2 primary modes:




[h5]Campaign Mode[/h5] 
[list]
[*] In campaign mode, you advance level by level, and at the end of the run, you'll receive HP based on your performance.
[*] A unit you used in the previous round can be picked up to stay with you in the subsequent level so you can choose it from the upgrades.
[*] Each new level, new enemy unit type will be added.
[*] With each successive level, the run gets harder.
[*] The last level has a boss and a significant tank battle.
[*] The HP will reset with each new run, therefore you must purchase a unit before playing again. Restarting the run will also cause the HP accumulated throughout the run to be lost.
[/list]

[h5]Free play[/h5] 
[list]
[*] Free to choose any map on any difficulty.
[*] Waves and unit types based on the chosen map
[*] While playing in Free Play mode, the player won't acquire HP.
[*] Units don't migrate to next round.
[/list]










[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888943/f69189a2ba7351f3f651b2aae448eae7d9d42998.png[/img]


[h2]NEW MAP[/h2] New map has been added:



[h5]Enemies Headquarters:[/h5] New end level map, that has a boss and big tanks, very challenging. It's  the enemy's city you went to their door step, don't expect them to act kindly.

There's a 2nd part to this map, when the level finishes a big blimp will come as a final boss, we wish you the best, winning this part; good challenge for who wants more.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888943/3b4eb510b4f5980a61520ee558be9e518a060eb6.png[/img]












[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888943/6b2ba4cbd5c14acf74ecb8033b4f11ef5b4c282f.png[/img]

[h5]Blimp[/h5] An airship boss which drops units on the battlefield.

notes.title: Update V0.3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888943/a8a4c185a61e2609320057a87712250a3b145eb2.png[/img]

[quote]Greetings,

You can update game to V0.3 

Update V0.3 brings a lot of new changes, based on community feedback and suggestions. More changes to core mechanic gameplay, and adjusting the difficulty based on new method. And much rework of different units based on suggestions and fixes.

List of changes and additions below. [/quote]




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888943/4c6b32a8e3f3d7965cf180da7e8f3f409506cbba.png[/img]
Commander Control: A skill based mechanic, will grant you killing large groups of enemies at later waves, and will let you kill high value targets with precision, if you land shots correctly.




[h3]Weapons and usage[/h3]
[list]
[*]Sniper    : Good for clearing single targets (Vehicles, Armored Units, Bazookas)
[*]Bazooka : Good for clearing groups of enemies.
[/list]

[h3]Controls[/h3]
[list]
[*]Left Click - Mouse    : Shoots equipped weapon.
[*]Right Click -  Mouse : Switches weapons.
[/list]

[h3]Special Projectiles[/h3]
[list]
[*]Sniper special bullet         : Each 3 successful consecutive shots will grant you a special bullet, that pierce through all enemies.
[*]Bazooka special projectile: Each bazooka projectile hits 3 enemy units simultaneously, will grant you special projectile that have bigger radius.
[/list]

Ammo will refill each new wave.
Keep in mind using commander at later waves is vital for winning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888943/8ca45583447bc8f147358b77e1af6619d8c344c1.gif[/img]





[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888943/f6ce2cbf114614bff0a1d3f6ac268a6012ac64b2.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Starting with equipped Spitfire.

[/list]

[list]
[*]Spawn rate: is speed of the enemy soldiers spawning, the bigger the number the more they spawn, the harder the game.
[*]Spawn rate is 0.6 by default.
[*]Spawn rate will increase by 0.35 each 10 allied soldiers on the battlefield
[*]Also spawn rate will increase on overall life time per Round, each wave will increase by 0.05.
[/list]
